title: The supplier CEO wants an exception
scenario: A supplier CEO emails your procurement lead directly, apologizing for an internal banking issue and asking for a one-time payment exception to keep your order on schedule. The email domain looks nearly identical to the supplier’s.

answers.A: Approve because a CEO-level request explains why the normal process is being bypassed.
answers.B: Verify the request with known supplier contacts and your vendor-change process before any exception.
answers.C: Escalate internally and ask the supplier to use its established commercial channel.

explanation: Authority can be used to justify the very exception that removes protection. Near-lookalike domains are a common impersonation tactic.
proTip: The higher the authority, the less reason to bypass controls silently.
